_source: 決算短信 / 有価証券報告書 セグメント注記。旧 scripts/add_segment_bridge_3110.py の埋め込み定数をそのまま移設（2026-08-26）
title: Segment Bridge - Nitto Boseki (3110)
intro: Segment profit total less corporate costs / eliminations reconciled to consolidated operating profit. All figures JPY mn.
Only 2 full FYs plus Q1 are disclosed on a comparable basis - too few for the 3-year hist_years array - hence this separate sheet rather than a 'segments' override block.

Consolidated operating margin is driven almost entirely by Electronic Materials (low-dielectric glass cloth for AI servers): 84% of total segment profit in FY2026/3 at a 31.6% segment margin, against four of the other five segments at or below 4%.

segments.label: Capital & Chemicals  資本・ケミカル

adjustment.revenue_note: Derived as a residual - the disclosed segment note quantifies the profit adjustment only.

consolidated.revenue_note: Q1 revenue 34,033 is the same figure used in the LTM bridge (118,229 - 28,231 + 34,033 = 124,031).
consolidated.da_note: CF statement, disclosed. The segment D&A breakdown does not tie exactly; the variance is shown, not forced.

notes: Segment profit is the disclosed segment operating profit; the adjustment row carries corporate costs and inter-segment eliminations.
Revenue adjustment is derived as (consolidated revenue - segment total) because the disclosed note quantifies the profit adjustment only.
Q1 FY2027/3 is a single quarter and is not annualised anywhere in this workbook.
This sheet is informational; no cell on the DCF Model sheet references it.
open_items: capex_pct = 8.5% (single value) applied to all 5 projection years
overrides_validator の ALLOWED_KEYS で capex_pct は数値スカラーのみ(配列は契約違反)。プロンプト指定の年次テーパー [0.15,0.13,0.10,0.085,0.080] を表現できず、ターミナル整合(capex/D&A = 1.02x)を優先して Y5 近傍の単一値を採用した。
Y1-Y2 の capex が実勢(FY2026/3 実績 売上比17.4%、建設仮勘定12,067)を大幅に過小評価
単一値8.5%のため増産投資期の初期2年の投資額が約半分になり、その分だけ Y1-Y2 の FCF が過大に出る。PGM/Exit いずれの Target も上振れ方向のバイアスを持つ。年次配列が必要なら capex_method='direct' への切替をスキーマ側で再検討すること。
Segment Bridge の tie-out 差異: Q1営業利益 -12、FY2026/3 D&A +40
開示セグメント数値(百万円丸め)の積上げと連結開示値の差。ゼロに強制せず差異行として表示。
